versions.content: Sub-functions of the service ReadDTCInformation The di- agnostics service ReadDTCInformation defines a number of sub-functions that are, as far as the modeling in AUTOSAR goes, identified by a textual identifier. These sub-functions are not modeled explicitly but can be specified by defining a DiagnosticReadDTCInformation and by setting the DiagnosticReadDTCIn- formation . category to the identifier of the respective sub-function. The possible values, as far as the AUTOSAR standard is concerned, are defined by [TPS_DEXT_01060].
